title: Harnessing Trust in Directed Graphs: Redefining Robustness of Graph Learning
abstract: arXiv:2306.02002v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Existing research on robust Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) focuses predominantly on undirected graphs, overlooking the trustworthiness inherent in the link directions of directed graphs. In this work, we analyze the limitations of current approaches from both the attack and defense perspectives and redefine the robustness of GNNs in directed graphs. From the attack side, we introduce a more realistic directed graph attack setting that addresses the shortcomings of existing attacks. From the defense side, we propose a simple yet effective message-passing framework that serves as a plug-in layer to strengthen GNN robustness while avoiding a false sense of robustness. Our findings show that the trust signals encoded in directed graphs can be harnessed to substantially improve the robustness of GNNs. translated_title: 利用有向图中的信任：重新定义图学习的鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 现有关于鲁棒图神经网络（GNN）的研究主要集中于无向图，忽视了有向图链接方向中固有的可信性。在本工作中，我们从攻击和防御两个角度分析了当前方法的局限性，并重新定义了有向图中GNN的鲁棒性。在攻击方面，我们引入了一种更贴近现实的有向图攻击设置，弥补了现有攻击方法的不足。在防御方面，我们提出了一个简单而有效的消息传递框架，可作为即插即用的插件层来增强GNN的鲁棒性，同时避免产生虚假的鲁棒性错觉。我们的研究结果表明，利用有向图中编码的信任信号可以显著提高GNN的鲁棒性。与现有防御策略结合时，该框架在实现最先进的鲁棒性能的同时，还保持了较高的干净数据准确率。
tldr: 该论文从攻击和防御两个角度重新定义了有向图上图神经网络的鲁棒性，并提出了一种即插即用的消息传递框架，通过利用有向图链接方向中蕴含的信任信号显著提升GNN的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper redefines the robustness of GNNs on directed graphs from both attack and defense perspectives, proposing a plug-and-play message-passing framework that harnesses trust signals encoded in link directions to substantially enhance GNN robustness.
